learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to humanity's role as caretakers or stewards of the Earth, as described in the Quran (2:30)?
learnings.learning: In Islamic theology, the term 'khalifah' refers to humanity's role as caretakers or stewards of the Earth, as described in the Quran (2:30).

learnings.question: In Islamic thought, which three roles are said to define the overall purpose of human life?
options: Gaining knowledge, serving others, and attaining fame
Following the five pillars, performing hajj, and fasting
Seeking wealth, building a family, and preserving culture
Worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah of the Earth, and preparing for the Hereafter
learnings.learning: Human life's purpose is said to revolve around three primary roles: worshiping Allah, serving as khalifah (steward) of the Earth, and preparing for the eternal Hereafter through accountability.

learnings.question: What does the Quranic teaching about an 'atom's weight' of good or evil (99:7-8) illustrate?
options: Every deed, no matter how small, will be accounted for by Allah
Intentions matter more than actions ever do
Only major sins are recorded by Allah
Good deeds automatically outweigh bad deeds
learnings.learning: The Quran teaches that every deed, no matter how small — 'an atom's weight' of good or evil — will be seen and accounted for by Allah.

learnings.question: Arabic is estimated to have around 12 million distinct words. Roughly how many words does the Oxford English Dictionary contain by comparison?
learnings.learning: Arabic has an estimated 12 million distinct words compared to roughly 170,000 in the Oxford English Dictionary — about a 71:1 ratio.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: When the Pareto Principle (80/20 rule) was tested against word frequency in the Quran, what percentage of the text did the 20 most common words actually make up?
learnings.learning: Testing the Pareto Principle against word frequency in the Quran showed the top 20 most repeated words account for only about 20.83% of the text, not 80%.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to the actual, lived unfolding of events in a person's life, as opposed to Allah's complete eternal plan?
learnings.learning: Qada' refers to the actual occurrence of events in a person's life, shaped by their actions and decisions, while Qadr is Allah's complete, eternal plan.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: According to the Islamic concept of Qada' and Qadr, what resolves the question of whether supplication (dua) matters if everything is already predestined?
options: Dua can change what actually unfolds, but that change was always already known as part of Allah's plan
Qadr can be entirely rewritten by a sincere enough dua
Only prophets' dua is able to alter what unfolds
Dua has no real effect since everything is already fixed
learnings.learning: Dua and one's actions can alter the Qada' (what actually happens), but that very change was always already known to Allah as part of His eternal Qadr.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which economist and cognitive scientist argued in 1971 that an information-rich world necessarily creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon argued in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention, since information consumes the attention of its recipients.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: A personal content-filtering system described pulling daily videos from hand-picked YouTube channels and using AI to filter them against one benchmark question. Who was that benchmark question written for?
options: A university student studying computer science
A general audience interested in self-improvement
A Muslim, Malaysian software engineer early in his career
learnings.learning: The automated content filter asks whether 'a Muslim, Malaysian software engineer early in his career' would actually benefit from a video before letting it through.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In the Scrum agile framework, which artifact visualizes a Sprint's progress and shows how much work remains?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart is the Scrum artifact that visualizes a Sprint's progress and shows the remaining work.

learnings.question: Which of the following is explicitly NOT one of the three key roles defined in the Scrum framework?
learnings.learning: Scrum defines exactly three key roles — Product Owner, Scrum Master, and Developers — and 'Project Manager' is explicitly not one of them.

learnings.question: Which psychologist demonstrated in the 1880s that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned material within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus proved in the 1880s that people forget about 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: What term, linked to 'Google Effect' research, describes the tendency to forget information more easily once it has been saved to a phone or computer?
learnings.learning: 'Digital Amnesia' describes how the brain treats writing something down or saving it digitally as permission to forget it — a 'Performance Paradox' of cognitive offloading.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state represents a device that is fully operational and actively transmitting data, with no power saving applied?
learnings.learning: L0 is the PCIe power state where a device is fully operational and active, transmitting data without any power saving.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: Which PCIe power state is almost completely powered down, offering the highest power savings but the longest wake-up time?
learnings.learning: L2 is the deepest PCIe power state, almost completely powered down, used for the longest periods of inactivity, with the highest power savings and longest wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
